description: This file contains implementation for managing Realtek SerDes (Serializer/Deserializer) hardware components, including init, configuration, reset, and calibration functions for varying hardware models (e.g., RTL838X, RTL839X, RTL930X). It defines enums, constants, structures, and functions to support low-level hardware control of SerDes modes, power, PLL configuration, and PHY link setup within a network device driver in Linux kernel environment.
